messages:
maya: FYI deploybot just gated RC-357 during the midnight change window — SBOM flagged a transitive vuln. canary is green but gate is blocking. do we pin, rollback, or delegate approval?
deploy-bot: automated scan -> release RC-357
```
SBOM alerts:
- libfoo 1.2.3 (direct)
- libbar 0.9.1 (transitive) — CVE-2026-4512 severity: LOW, no known exploit
Action required: gate_tripped (vuln_scan)
``` 
dan: low severity + no exploit sounds fine to me if canary is green. what does security say? :thinking_face:
tess: quick take from sec: low severity transitive is usually acceptable with a tracked mitigation. need a follow-up plan in release notes and an owner to patch within 72h. if canary were failing i'd push rollback.
alex: change window ends in ~1h45m. if we roll back now we'll miss the late-afternoon push. can we do a delegated approval to security-ops for off-hours low-sev transitive cases? keep release on schedule.
maya: proposal: delegate to security-ops for this class (transitive, LOW, no exploit) with conditions: (1) canary stays green for 30m, (2) add release-note entry + mitigation ticket, (3) patch owner assigned within 48h. ackable by :thumbsup:. thoughts?
security-ops: @maya we can accept that delegation for the defined scope. we'll take ownership of the tracking ticket and monitor canary. please add the mitigation ticket and tag #sec-triage.
maya: added ticket and owner (tess) to the release notes and pinned to the release docs.
maya: release notes snippet added:
```
- Security: transitive libbar (CVE-2026-4512, LOW) flagged by SBOM. No active exploit. Canary verified. Security delegation approved; patch ETA: 48h. Ticket: #4572-sec-patch
```
dan: ok — if canary stays green for 30m i'm good to proceed. +1
alex: forwarding to deploybot to continue rollout with delegation flag.
deploy-bot: resuming rollout for RC-357 with delegate_approval=security-ops; canary watch 30m. logs: https://internal.ci/rc-357/logs
tess: i'll pick up the patch and update #4572. tagging @security-ops when a fix is merged.
security-ops: :white_check_mark: monitoring. will escalate if any exploitation evidence appears. otherwise we'll close the delegation after patch lands.
maya: thanks all — documenting outcome in the release channel. will file post-release checklist to confirm patch and close ticket. :raised_hands:
